issue: pump_diagnostic_audit.py staged its receipt with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=args.output.parent, ...) without creating that directory first, so any --output whose parent did not already exist died with FileNotFoundError and published nothing.
affected: scripts/pump_diagnostic_audit.py:main at base, the NamedTemporaryFile staging call
finding: The two sibling audit CLIs that share this staging pattern already create the destination parent: scripts/pump_strict_ordered_logs.py runs `a.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` immediately before its NamedTemporaryFile, and scripts/pump_data_order.py does the same before publish_certificate. The diagnostic audit, which migrates and differential receipts call after every bounded run, could only publish into a directory tree that some other step had already created.

change.location: immediately after the audit result and its source digests are computed, before staging
change.unchanged_behaviour: report parsing, log-pair admission, panic/anchor/comparand comparison, no-replace publication (os.link on POSIX, os.rename on nt), source-report re-read discipline, staging cleanup and the mismatch exit status

base_fresh_parent.stderr: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '<temp>/fresh/nested/.audit.json.adzglp4c'

base_existing_parent_control.note: the same report and a pre-existing parent publish correctly, so the defect is the missing parent, not the audit

added: test_fresh_output_parent_is_created: a matched one-case report publishes into <temp>/fresh/nested, the receipt carries the source digest, the report is unchanged and no staging file remains
test_fresh_output_parent_still_reports_mismatches: a panic-message difference publishes into <temp>/fresh, exits 1 and records both panic strings
tests.before: 2 errors (both cases: FileNotFoundError from the staging call)

limits: This changes where the audit may write, not what it audits; the receipt payload, its digests and the mismatch exit status are untouched. The destination still refuses to replace an existing receipt on POSIX.
